# Mylo Kaye

> Practical Dynamics 365 Customer Insights tools, documentation, browser extensions, and email utilities by Mylo Kaye.

## Site

- Home: https://mylokaye.info/
- Privacy policy: https://mylokaye.info/privacy.html
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/mylokaye
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mylo-kaye/

## About

Mylo Kaye is based in Manchester, U.K. and works on customer experience tooling for Dynamics 365 CRM across global markets.

The site highlights practical projects that help teams test Dynamics 365 Customer Insights forms, document form implementation, work with email assets, and prototype HTML form experiences.

## Featured Projects

- D365-CIJ-Forms-Debugger: https://github.com/mylokaye/D365-CIJ-Forms-Debugger
  - Browser extension for testing and validating Dynamics 365 Customer Insights forms by bypassing form cache during development.
  - Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/dynamics-365-form-debugge/kdhnliicfgopcijgepghgohnhafphohf
  - Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/dynamics-365-form-debugge/ceoaoafhphcpdokfdfkiilmndbepbbec?hl=en-GB

- D365-CIJ-Forms-Docs: https://github.com/mylokaye/D365-CIJ-Forms-Docs
  - Documentation for creating, customizing, and managing Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys forms.

- Pattens-basic: https://github.com/mylokaye/Pattens-basic
  - Browser-based email tools for email lists, email HTML, campaign names, and campaign assets.

- forms-v2: https://github.com/mylokaye/forms-v2
  - UI and UX testing ground for basic HTML forms.

## Preferred Summary

Mylo Kaye builds practical Dynamics 365 Customer Insights tools, including a Form Debugger browser extension, documentation for forms, email tooling, and HTML form experiments.
